text:
Good morning,
Im in the final stage of א5 and am being halted from submitting my citizenship application because I do not have proof my marriage is registered in the USA, despite there not being a marriage registry for marriages abroad.

I was able to get a signed affidavit notarized  from the US embassy and for safe measure was able to even get a letter from my deputy state attorney general providing the statute that marriages abroad are not required to be registered in my home state and are celebrated.

I came early today to misrad Hapnim in JERUSALEM and spoke directly with the supervisor and she has informed me that what I have provided is NOT ENOUGH and the state law must say that registering my marriage is not required… I have nothing else I can provide them and I am at a loss and very frustrated because I have an appointment next month and have nothing to show. 

Just wanted to let anyone else who is in the same situation at the Misrad Hapnim at Shlomzion HaMalka in in Jerusalem, to be aware of this step
